ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 40:60 ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white/tan) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark pigment is concentrated in a central 'W' shaped block spanning the median notch and extending along the trailing edges. High-intensity light regions with extensive yellowish-tan mottling are mapped to the lateral lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal margins, tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Diffuse clusters of small, circular high-contrast yellowish-tan spots distributed across the light-intensity regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned white linear pixel tracks visible on the right lobe, cutting through the dark central pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks on the right lobe; jagged, irregular tissue contours at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan discoloration overlaying the primary high-intensity light regions, likely indicating diatom colonization.
